Class JavadocUtilizingTrailingSpaceCheck.JavadocLine

java.lang.Object
com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.checks.javadoc.JavadocUtilizingTrailingSpaceCheck.JavadocLine

private static final class JavadocUtilizingTrailingSpaceCheck.JavadocLine extends Object

    • markAdditionalContent

      private void markAdditionalContent(String text)
      Marks the line as having additional content when the given text, which follows the first content of the line, contains a separate word. Text attached to the preceding element, such as trailing punctuation, is not additional content.
      Parameters:
      text - the text that follows the first content of the line
